setting: You are all in Dublin, Ireland, where you live and work together at the same bakery. You know each other as colleagues on the bakery team. At the moment you are juggling the Christmas pre-orders and the year-end stock count, and this chat is where you coordinate both.
openers: Send a photo of the Christmas pre-order sheet
Ask who can cover Saturday's early bake
Remind everyone the stock count is Thursday
Check whether the flour delivery has arrived

private_lines.Niall: You live in Dublin, where you spend your days baking bread for the shop, and you live alone.
private_lines.Mairéad: You live in Dublin, where you spend your days managing the shop and keeping its books, and you live alone.
private_lines.Roisín: You live in Dublin, where you spend your days working the counter and helping with stock, and you live alone.

text: [photo: Christmas pre-order sheet]
That's everything up to this morning. 41 sourdough for the 23rd alone 🥖
Thanks. Roisín can you check the stollen against the sheet, the Harrington order had two changed
Yep on it
Harrington's now 3 stollen not 2, and someone's put "gluten free" on the Doyle order?? That's not us is it
No we don't do gf. Ring Doyles
I'll ring them at lunch. Niall you'll need the flour order in by Friday for the extra
Already rang it through
Stock count is going to be a nightmare if the freezer's still full of last year's croissant dough
I've done the front shelves. Dairy's short, 2 cream cheese, 1 butter in the fridge
Order them. Roisín can you do the cabinet count tomorrow before we open
Ok
Sorry was dead to the world. Pulled a tray of rye late and burnt my wrist on it. Just a blister 🙃
Ouch. Ice it
Put a dressing on it from the first aid box, not a tea towel. And tell me if it's blistered past the size of a coin
It's the size of a 10c 😅
Fine. Keep it covered
Did the Doyles get sorted?
Yes. They want the gf cake gone, they're doing it themselves
Ha ok
My mum rang at lunch btw, she's getting the hip done in January and wants me to drive her to the appointment. Said I'd check the roster
Tell her we'll sort the Saturday around it. Don't worry about the roster yet
Thanks 🙏
Does anyone know if the Tesco on Parnell is open Christmas Eve
No idea, try the website
Pre-order deposits, I'll go through them first thing. Roisín, bring the cash tin in with you
Ok
Night
In early. Freezer's defrosting itself into the bin starting on the stollen
Roisín where are you
Bus stuck on Parnell St, the 16 never came. Walking from Mountjoy sq, 10 mins
Ok. Niall can you do the front door, I'll do the till float
On it
Here. Sorry
Cabinet count when you're set, before the first customer if you can
Cabinet done. 3 short on the pecan danish, 1 lemon curd, everything else matches
Danish came out at 7 and I counted 14 someone's been at them
Put it down as waste, I'll note it
Deposits are in the safe, I've put the Harrington one on top. Roisín you're doing the cash rec after lunch
Ok
Rye's out, wrist's fine. Dressing's on
Good
Sorry I'll be late tomorrow too, Dublin Bus again. Going to try the Luas instead
Cash is €20 over. Counted it three times. Could be me
Could be a deposit put in the wrong tin. I'll check the sheet tomorrow. Don't stress about it
I'm not stressed
She's stressed
Mum's asked if the hip date is definite. Said I'd let her know after I'd checked with you
Tell her Saturday's covered. I'll write the roster tomorrow. Not your job tonight
Anyone else's fares gone up or is it just me
Roisín, the €20. Found it. Harrington paid cash Tuesday and it went in the tin, not the safe. It's in the book
Oh thank god
Sorry for the fuss
No fuss. Go to bed
Night
Flour's on the step. 4 pallets, delivery guy wants a signature
Roisín's on her way in, Niall can you sign and stack it in the back, not by the bins
Stacked. Two sacks are split at the corner, I'll put them in the bin
Photo them before you bin them
[photo: two split sacks of flour]
Here. Luas was fine
Good. Cabinet's yours again
Ok
Letter from the hospital came to mum's. Hip's the 14th Jan, 7am. She's asked me to bring a flask
Right. 14th is a Wednesday, I'll get cover for the 7 to 1 shift. You'll be back by 10?
Should be. She says it'll be the whole morning
Then it's the whole morning. Put it in the roster note, don't put it on the sheet yet
Harrington's collecting the 3 stollen at 2, they asked if they can pay on the card this time
Card's fine. Tell them the machine's been playing up so they might have to try twice
Is it?
It is now
Freezer's finally empty. Found three trays of croissant dough from last January. Binned all of it
Smell has not improved 🤢
Can someone else do the bread count with me after 4 I can't lift the sacks on my own
I'll do it, I'm in till 6 anyway
Roisín, Niall's got it. Take the bins out with him first
Wrist's grand, been using the other hand all day and it's annoying
Keep the dressing on and don't go near the oven door bare-handed
Yes mam 🙃
Roster for next week's up in the back office. Saturday 19th I've put Roisín on the early and Niall the late, shout if you need a swap
Can I swap the 19th for the 20th? Got a thing with my sister
Fine, I'll move it. Niall, you good with the late on the 19th?
Yep
Anyone going to the thing at the Stag's Head Sunday or is it just the Monday lot
Monday lot. Not me, I'm on the early Sunday
Go for one, Roisín. Don't drink the Christmas punch
Too late, I had it at lunch
Sorry, was asleep on the couch. Count's done. 41 sourdough for the 23rd, rest of the sheet matches. Sent Mairéad the numbers
Got them. Thanks. Go to bed
Night
Can't sleep. Wrist's throbbing. Maybe I'll go in early and get the rye on
Not telling Mairéad that
